#heatmap cm
```{r}
# heatmap cm: cell-number benchmark module confusion matrix

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# Step 0. IO

out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_cell_number_4000g_6tp"

truth_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "truth_params")
module_result_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "module_result")
cm_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "module_confusion_matrix")

timepoint_ref_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_timepoint_number_4000g_20000c"
timepoint_ref_truth <- file.path(
  timepoint_ref_dir,
  "truth_params",
  "truth_params_timepoint6_4000g_20000c.rds"
)

dir.create(cm_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cell_number_vec <- c(20000, 10500, 6000, 3000, 1500, 600)
run_cell_vec <- c(10500, 6000, 3000, 1500, 600)

n_repeat <- 1

compare_by <- "condition"
group1 <- "cond_1"
group2 <- "cond_2"

cell_number_cols <- c(
  "20000" = "#A8C7E6",
  "10500" = "#57ADDE",
  "6000"  = "#17441e",
  "3000"  = "#3a621f",
  "1500"  = "#357090",
  "600"   = "#2F6F73"
)

module_levels <- 0:7
module_labels <- paste0("M", module_levels)

module_name_map <- tibble(
  module_id = module_levels,
  module_label = factor(module_labels, levels = module_labels),
  module_name = c(
    "Non-rhythmic",
    "Stable rhythm",
    "Rhythm gain",
    "Rhythm loss",
    "Amplitude-enhanced rhythmic",
    "Amplitude-attenuated rhythmic",
    "Phase-advanced rhythmic",
    "Phase-delayed rhythmic"
  )
)

stopifnot(file.exists(timepoint_ref_truth))

# Step 1. Helper

make_module_confusion_one <- function(cell_i, rep_i = 1) {

  fill_high_i <- cell_number_cols[as.character(cell_i)]

  file_tag <- paste0(
    "cell", cell_i,
    "_rep", rep_i,
    "_", compare_by,
    "_", group1, "_vs_", group2
  )

  module_result_file <- file.path(
    module_result_dir,
    paste0("module_result_", file_tag, ".rds")
  )

  truth_file <- file.path(
    truth_dir,
    paste0("truth_params_cell", cell_i, "_4000g_6tp.rds")
  )

  if (cell_i == 20000) {
    truth_file <- timepoint_ref_truth
  }

  stopifnot(file.exists(module_result_file), file.exists(truth_file))

  module_result <- readRDS(module_result_file)
  truth_i <- readRDS(truth_file)

  truth_df <- truth_i$gene_meta %>%
    transmute(
      gene = as.character(gene),
      Truth_num = as.integer(module)
    )

  pred_df <- module_result %>%
    transmute(
      gene = as.character(gene),
      Pred_num = as.integer(module_map)
    )

  eval_df <- pred_df %>%
    left_join(truth_df, by = "gene") %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Truth_num),
      !is.na(Pred_num),
      Truth_num %in% module_levels,
      Pred_num %in% module_levels
    )

  stopifnot(nrow(eval_df) == 4000)

  conf_df <- eval_df %>%
    count(Truth_num, Pred_num, name = "Freq") %>%
    complete(
      Truth_num = module_levels,
      Pred_num = module_levels,
      fill = list(Freq = 0)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      module_name_map %>% select(module_id, Truth = module_label),
      by = c("Truth_num" = "module_id")
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      module_name_map %>% select(module_id, Pred = module_label),
      by = c("Pred_num" = "module_id")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Truth = factor(Truth, levels = module_labels),
      Pred = factor(Pred, levels = rev(module_labels)),
      target_n_cell = cell_i,
      repeat_id = rep_i,
      text_col = ifelse(Freq >= max(Freq, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.55, "white", "black")
    )

  conf_wide <- conf_df %>%
    select(Truth_num, Pred_num, Freq) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Pred_num,
      values_from = Freq,
      names_prefix = "Pred_M"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Truth_num) %>%
    mutate(
      target_n_cell = cell_i,
      repeat_id = rep_i,
      .before = 1
    )

  acc_df <- eval_df %>%
    summarise(
      target_n_cell = cell_i,
      repeat_id = rep_i,
      N = n(),
      Accuracy = mean(Truth_num == Pred_num),
      Correct = sum(Truth_num == Pred_num)
    )

  p_cm <- ggplot(conf_df, aes(x = Truth, y = Pred, fill = Freq)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = Freq, color = text_col),
      size = 5.5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "grey96",
      high = fill_high_i,
      name = "Count"
    ) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(format(cell_i, big.mark = ","), " cells"),
      x = "Ground truth module",
      y = "Predicted module"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 23),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, colour = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  out_prefix <- paste0("CM_module_truth_vs_pred_cell", cell_i, "_rep", rep_i)

  ggsave(
    file.path(cm_dir, paste0(out_prefix, ".pdf")),
    p_cm,
    width = 8,
    height = 7
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(cm_dir, paste0(out_prefix, ".png")),
    p_cm,
    width = 8,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )

  write_csv(conf_df, file.path(cm_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_long.csv")))
  write_csv(conf_wide, file.path(cm_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_wide.csv")))
  write_csv(acc_df, file.path(cm_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_accuracy.csv")))

  list(
    plot = p_cm,
    long_df = conf_df,
    wide_df = conf_wide,
    acc_df = acc_df,
    eval_df = eval_df
  )
}

# Step 2. Run all cell-number conditions

cm_all <- list()
run_id <- 1

for (cell_i in cell_number_vec) {
  for (rep_i in seq_len(n_repeat)) {
    message("============================================================")
    message("Making confusion matrix | target_n_cell = ", cell_i, " | repeat = ", rep_i)

    cm_all[[run_id]] <- make_module_confusion_one(
      cell_i = cell_i,
      rep_i = rep_i
    )

    run_id <- run_id + 1
  }
}

# Step 3. Save combined tables

cm_long_all <- bind_rows(lapply(cm_all, function(x) x$long_df)) %>%
  arrange(desc(target_n_cell), repeat_id, Truth_num, Pred_num)

cm_wide_all <- bind_rows(lapply(cm_all, function(x) x$wide_df)) %>%
  arrange(desc(target_n_cell), repeat_id, Truth_num)

cm_acc_all <- bind_rows(lapply(cm_all, function(x) x$acc_df)) %>%
  arrange(desc(target_n_cell), repeat_id)

write_csv(
  cm_long_all,
  file.path(cm_dir, "CM_module_truth_vs_pred_all_long.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  cm_long_all,
  file.path(cm_dir, "CM_module_truth_vs_pred_all_long.rds")
)

write_csv(
  cm_wide_all,
  file.path(cm_dir, "CM_module_truth_vs_pred_all_wide.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  cm_wide_all,
  file.path(cm_dir, "CM_module_truth_vs_pred_all_wide.rds")
)

write_csv(
  cm_acc_all,
  file.path(cm_dir, "CM_module_truth_vs_pred_accuracy_summary.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  cm_acc_all,
  file.path(cm_dir, "CM_module_truth_vs_pred_accuracy_summary.rds")
)

print(cm_acc_all)

message("Finished cell-number module confusion matrices.")
message("Output directory: ", cm_dir)
```
